changed.title: A two-state trace computes each parity coefficient of the nonlinear cyclic row, including singular three-tap mixes
changed.statement:
∀ (k : ℕ) [NeZero k] (d : ℕ),
  let I := ZMod k
  let B := ZMod 2
  let V := I → B
  let sign := fun (t : B) => if t = 0 then (1 : ℤ) else -1
  let mix := fun (x : V) (i : I) => x (i-(d : I)) + x i + x (i+(d : I))
  let nl := fun (y : V) (j : I) => y j + (1+y (j+1))*y (j+2)
  let lifts := fun (a : V) => Finset.univ.filter (fun u : V => mix u = a)
  let transfer := fun (u b : V) (j : ℕ) =>
    let i := (j : I)
    (fun (left right : B) =>
      sign ((u i+b i+b (i-2))*left + b (i-1)*left*right) : Matrix B B ℤ)
  let g := Nat.gcd k d
  ∀ (a b : V),
    (∑ x : V, sign (dotProduct a x + dotProduct b (nl (mix x)))) =
      ∑ u ∈ lifts a, Matrix.trace (((List.range k).map (transfer u b)).prod) ∧
    (lifts a).card = (if (∃ y : V, mix y = a) then
      (if 3 ∣ (k/g) then 4^g else 1) else 0)
changed.unlocks: Computes signed transitions for each mask in the two cyclic key schedules, including singular widths.
changed.context: Expand the masked nonlinear row on mixed bits. Site i contributes a linear field u_i+b_i+b_(i-2) and the neighbor product with coefficient b_(i-1). Expanding the trace around the indexed cycle chooses one bit per site and gives this sign. Walsh inversion through the symmetric mix retains exactly the lifts of a. Each spacing orbit has length k/g. In the homogeneous lift equation, consecutive bits A,B force A+B,A,B repeatedly. Closing the orbit leaves four choices if three divides its length and one otherwise. Translate any one lift by this kernel.

changed.title: Known result rebuilt: Hadamard correlation is bounded by the real rank and squared norm of the predictor
changed.statement:
∀ (n : ℕ) (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ), 0 < n →
  (∀ i j, H i j = 1 ∨ H i j = -1) →
  (∀ i j, (∑ c, H i c * H j c) = if i = j then (n : ℝ) else 0) →
  ∀ A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ,
    (∑ i, ∑ j, H i j * A i j)^2 ≤
      (n : ℝ) * (A.rank : ℝ) * (∑ i, ∑ j, (A i j)^2)
changed.unlocks: Bounds agreement of arbitrary low-rank predictors for an orthogonal sign target.
changed.context: Project the columns of H orthogonally onto the column space of A. The projection has squared Frobenius norm n times rank A since HHᵀ=nI. Its inner product with A equals the original correlation. Apply Cauchy-Schwarz.
